title: Bennett Venture Academy
subtitle: Washington, D.C. May 29-31, 2026
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Bennett Venture Academy. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & Smithsonian Museum of American History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Visit the Smithsonian Museum of American History
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue 
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial 
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (two nights)
  

Day 2: United States Capitol Building Tour & United States Botanic Garden

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the United States Capitol 
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit
  • Visit the United States Botanic Garden
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture 
  • Visit the International Spy Museum 
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: Arlington National Cemetery & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park 
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch 
  • Souvenir shopping
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Bennett Venture Academy, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2026! 🏛️
introText: From powerful memorials to world-renowned museums, this Washington, D.C. experience brings American history and civics to life at every turn. Students will stand at iconic landmarks like the Lincoln Memorial and Washington Monument, explore the U.S. Capitol and Supreme Court, and discover inspiring stories at Smithsonian museums and the National Museum of African American History and Culture. With meaningful sites like Arlington National Cemetery and engaging stops throughout the nation’s capital, this trip offers the perfect blend of education, reflection, and discovery—an experience your students will never forget.
